nativeIncrementalCompaction.existingMode0: migration_required; explicit allow_blocking migration uses atomic full VACUUM once; never periodic.
limits: Progress callbacks and 1ms busy timeout are cooperative limits, not hard filesystem latency guarantees.
A single page move/commit can exceed the 25ms target; no zero-impact or billion-row acceptance claim.
Mode0 conversion blocks the worker and requires temporary disk space proportional to database size; explicit maintenance window and backup/recovery plan required before execution.
In WAL mode logical page reclamation can precede main-file shrink; returned database_bytes and wal_bytes report current physical files.
Existing ordinary foreground WAL-pressure and shutdown checkpoint policy retained; periodic reclaim performs neither TRUNCATE nor full VACUUM.
No tests, runtime calls, migration, capability probes, patch-apply checks, or checksum comparisons were run.
